create_AdaptiveMask_soft_mask: create an AdaptiveMask module to apply soft masking that gradually masks out the last K values of an input tensor
build_AdaptiveSpan_attention_span: build an AdaptiveSpan module to learn attention span length from data for each self-attention head in a Transformer
test_AdaptiveMask_forward: test the AdaptiveMask forward method to apply a learned soft mask to an input tensor and return masked output
review_AdaptiveSpan_trim_memory: review the AdaptiveSpan trim_memory method to trim unnecessary key and value cache tensors and reduce computation
summarize_AdaptiveSpan_get_loss: summarize the AdaptiveSpan get_loss method which returns a regularization loss term for controlling the learned span length
